description: The transport layer (PROTOCOL.md §4-§11): the handshake, the frozen control subset and the message envelope. Only this layer carries the protocol number. Fields are only ever added; a receiver ignores a field it does not know.

unknown_interface.description: The object does not implement that interface.

unsupported_version.description: The interface is not served at that version; data.versions lists the offered ones.

unknown_method.description: The interface version has no such method.

invalid_args.description: The call's args (or its envelope) do not match the method's schema; the message names the first violation.

same_build_required.description: The interface is same_build and the client's lw_version is not the daemon's.

not_loaded.description: The method needs the workspace and loading it failed; data carries the header's state and error.

retiring.description: The daemon is retiring and accepts no new operation from this client.

forbidden.description: Not allowed for this connection (e.g. cancelling another connection's task).

no_transport.description: The connection agreed on no transport version (no overlap of the two ranges); only the frozen control subset is served. data.protocol and data.protocol_min give the daemon's range.

internal.description: The call failed inside the daemon. A client treats an unknown code as internal.

ping.description: Control request (PROTOCOL.md §7); the reply is control.replies.ping.

status.description: Control request (PROTOCOL.md §7); the reply is control.replies.status.

stop.description: Control request (PROTOCOL.md §7): the server exits after the reply (control.replies.stop).

retire.description: Control request (PROTOCOL.md §7): the server accepts no new operation and exits once idle; the reply is control.replies.retire.

error.description: The reply to an interface call that could not be processed.

sub_id.description: The subscription (loomworks.Root/1 subscribe): an opaque string.

task_id.description: The opaque task id (loomworks.Common/1 TaskId, a string).

meta.description: start: the task's meta (loomworks.Common/1 TaskMeta); for an interface method's task it names the object, iface, v and method.

result.description: done of an interface method's task: its task result, typed by the method's schema (PROTOCOL.md §14.1).

stream.description: line: out, note or err (a client shows an unknown one as err); output: stdout or stderr. An open string.

text.description: line: the line's text, without terminal escape sequences (API.md §4.2). output: the chunk, when it is valid UTF-8 (else data).

data.description: output: the chunk's bytes in base64 (RFC 4648 §4), when they are not valid UTF-8; exactly one of text and data.

role.description: line: the line's presentation role (API.md §4.2); absent = plain. An open string: the interface defines the values.

pct.description: progress: the task's integer percent; sent only when it changes.

exit_code.description: done: the task's exit code, 0 for success. Present on every done.

error.description: done: the refusal or failure a client prints as lw: <error>; absent on success.

control.description: The replies of the frozen control requests (PROTOCOL.md §7), keyed by request kind.

busy_clients.description: Connections besides the asking one that own a running task or have a request in flight.

idle_deadline.description: Wall-clock seconds; absent when something besides the asker keeps the server up.
